name: Agent
description: Agent represents an AI agent definition with Graphton configuration.

fields.name: ApiVersion
fields.description: API version for this resource type.

fields.name: Metadata
fields.description:
Standard resource metadata including name, id, labels, and tags.
 Agents belong to an organization and can be PUBLIC or PRIVATE.
 Reference format: "org/slug" (e.g., "stigmer/web-search", "acme/data-analyst")

fields.name: Status
fields.description: System-managed status containing audit information and default instance ID.
